stories.title: Can S. Korea turn surprise run into first Asian Games basketball gold in 12 years?

en.title: Can S. Korea turn surprise run into first Asian Games basketball gold in 12 years?
en.summary: South Korea's men's basketball team has advanced through four consecutive victories at the 2026 Asian Games, including an upset win against Jordan. Star forward Lee Hyun-jung scored 28 points in the match, raising expectations for a potential gold medal.

stories.title: Team Korea Departs for 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games

en.title: Team Korea Departs for 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games
en.summary: South Korea's national team delegation of 122 athletes and administrators departed for Japan on Thursday to compete in the 2026 Asian Games hosted by Aichi Prefecture and Nagoya. The team includes table tennis star Shin Yu-bin and other competitors.

stories.title: S. Korea expands customs cooperation with Central Asian nations

en.title: S. Korea expands customs cooperation with Central Asian nations
en.summary: South Korea's customs agency signed memorandums of understanding with Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, and Tajikistan to enhance cooperation on customs matters and intellectual property protection. The agreements aim to combat the distribution of counterfeit Korean products in the region.

stories.title: Special Counsel Raids NEC, Regional Offices as Part of Ballot Shortage Probe

en.title: Special Counsel Raids NEC, Regional Offices as Part of Ballot Shortage Probe
en.summary: A special counsel team conducted a raid on the National Election Commission's headquarters Thursday morning as part of an investigation into ballot shortages during June 3 local elections and other alleged irregularities.

stories.title: Seoul stocks open higher despite first Fed rate hike in over 3 yrs

en.title: Seoul stocks open higher despite first Fed rate hike in over 3 yrs
en.summary: South Korea's stock market gained ground Thursday as technology stocks rose, even after the Federal Reserve increased its base rate by a quarter point to combat inflation. The Korea Composite Stock Price Index advanced 0.1 percent to 6,724.46.

stories.title: U.S Embassy runs Korea-US alliance ad on S. Korea's high-speed rail network

en.title: U.S Embassy runs Korea-US alliance ad on S. Korea's high-speed rail network
en.summary: The US Embassy launched an advertisement on South Korea's KTX high-speed trains promoting the Korea-US alliance as part of commemorations for the 250th anniversary of US independence. The 30-second video will air for one month with the message "Two Souls, One Story."

stories.title: (LEAD) Seoul stocks open higher despite first Fed rate hike in over 3 yrs

en.title: (LEAD) Seoul stocks open higher despite first Fed rate hike in over 3 yrs
en.summary: Seoul stocks opened higher Thursday, with technology shares leading gains despite the Federal Reserve's first rate increase in over three years.

stories.title: (URGENT) Seoul stocks open higher despite first Fed rate hike in over 3 yrs

en.title: (URGENT) Seoul stocks open higher despite first Fed rate hike in over 3 yrs
en.summary: Seoul stocks opened higher Thursday following a Federal Reserve rate hike, the first increase in over three years.

stories.title: Team Korea’s young guns set sights on Asian Games glory

en.title: Team Korea's young guns set sights on Asian Games glory
en.summary: South Korea's delegation to the 2026 Asian Games includes established stars alongside emerging athletes. Park Jun-soon, a 20-year-old drafted sixth overall by the Doosan Bears in 2025, impressed during his rookie season with 91 games played.

stories.title: US Fed Raises Benchmark Rate by 25 Basis Points for First Time in over 3 Years

en.title: US Fed Raises Benchmark Rate by 25 Basis Points for First Time in over 3 Years
en.summary: The Federal Reserve increased its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to a target range of 3.75 to 4 percent. The decision followed a unanimous vote by the Federal Open Market Committee.

stories.title: South Korea, 5 Central Asian Countries Adopt Seoul Declaration at Inaugural Summit

en.title: South Korea, 5 Central Asian Countries Adopt Seoul Declaration at Inaugural Summit
en.summary: South Korea and five Central Asian countries adopted the Seoul Declaration at their first summit, establishing a 30-year cooperation framework led by President Lee Jae Myung.

stories.title: Lee Calls for S. Korea-Central Asia Cooperation for Next 30 Years

en.title: Lee Calls for S. Korea-Central Asia Cooperation for Next 30 Years
en.summary: President Lee Jae Myung called for South Korea and Central Asia to collaborate over the next 30 years, building on three decades of existing cooperation.

en.title: Snap, Nvidia, AWS, and Salesforce Enter AR Glasses Market
en.summary: Snap is partnering with Nvidia, AWS, and Salesforce to expand into the augmented reality glasses market.

stories.title: [속보] 국회 법사위, '김승원 청문보고서' 與주도 채택…국힘 퇴장

en.title: [Breaking] National Assembly Judiciary Committee Adopts 'Kim Seung-won Hearing Report' Led by Ruling Party...Opposition Walks Out
en.summary: The National Assembly's Judiciary Committee adopted a hearing report on Kim Seung-won under ruling party leadership. The opposition party representatives withdrew from the proceedings.

stories.title: Fed 금리 올렸는데 오히려 뛰었다…美 10년물 5% 돌파한 이유 [심성미의 중앙은행 워치]

en.title: Fed raised rates but yields jumped instead…Reason U.S. 10-year bond surpassed 5%
en.summary: U.S. 10-year bond yields rose above 5 percent despite the Federal Reserve increasing interest rates, according to a report examining central bank dynamics.

stories.title: 건당 3만원에 혹한 운반책들...60억원대 마약 유통조직 검거

en.title: Lured by 30,000 won per delivery...600 million won drug trafficking organization busted
en.summary: Police arrested a drug distribution network after couriers were recruited with payments of 30,000 won per delivery, with the organization handling hundreds of millions of won in narcotics.

en.title: Posted "airport bombing" threat…Court orders police to pay 22.77 million won in damages
en.summary: A court ruled that police must pay compensation of 22.77 million won to someone who posted a threatening message about bombing an airport.
